title: Dream Days
summary: "Dream Days" by Kenneth Grahame is a collection of children's fiction and childhood reminiscences published in 1898. A sequel to "The Golden Age," it follows the same family of five children through stories that capture an unsentimental view of childhood. Adults remain oblivious to the young people's true concerns, griefs, and rages. The collection is best known for including Grahame's beloved tale "The Reluctant Dragon," which has overshadowed the other selections in the book's legacy.
